name: cosmos-sources-tools
description: Fetch, verify, and locally archive daily source content from CLS and Knowledge Planet.

interface.shortDescription: Archive daily CLS and Knowledge Planet content.
interface.longDescription: Retrieves and semantically filters the complete China Standard Time CLS telegraph feed, or uses the user's signed-in Chrome session to verify and archive every topic and attachment from one Knowledge Planet Beijing calendar day. Both skills write source-grounded local Markdown without introducing external model credentials.
defaultPrompt: Fetch and filter today's AI-related CLS telegraph feed.
Archive every topic and attachment from a Knowledge Planet for one Beijing calendar date.
